name: The Flame Engine
description: Brings my Flameperfect texture packs to life: startup intros, animated menus and loading screens, themed lists and popups.

play-intro.name: Play pack intros
play-intro.description: Plays the pack's intro animation when GD opens. You can also click to skip it.

check-updates.name: Check for updates
check-updates.description: When GD opens, check if there's a newer version of The Flame Engine and offer to update it.
